**Formula used:**

Percentage (P) = [(Current Year - Previous Year)/Previous Year] × 100

**Calculation:**

Percentage growth in the loan disbursement over the previous years,

For the Year 2016 - 2017

⇒ Growth in 2017 = (10/75) × 100 = 13.33%

For the Year 2017 - 2018

⇒ Growth in 2017 = (40/85) × 100 = 47.05%

The year 2018 - 2019

⇒ Growth in 2017 = (20/125) × 100 = 16%

The year 2019 - 2020

⇒ Growth in 2017 = (45/145) × 100 = 31.03%

**∴ The maximum percentage growth in the loan disbursement over the previous year was in 2018.**
